title: Compyla diagnostic
description: The one diagnostics shape every operation and host returns (markdown-spec.md §10). Registry metadata such as stage and strictPromotable lives in diagnostics.json, not on the object.

line.description: 1-based source line. Absent for document-level diagnostics (e.g. a template issue) and when the input was IR without positions.

path.description: JSON Pointer (RFC 6901) to the IR node the diagnostic is about, e.g. /body/0/children/2.
